name: Blue Future Technologiegebiet / Eisenach-Stockhausen data center proposal
developer: FAB Unternehmensgruppe (area developer; investor/operator not named)
notes: MDR (checked 2026-08-12) reports the Eisenach city council on 2026-07-02 backed a residents' petition (19:16) to preserve the ~80-86 ha agricultural area near Stockhausen and the mayor withdrew the administration's application for the next planning steps, so the data-center land-use plan is stopped (vorerst gestoppt). Earlier March 2026 regional reporting described the planned technology area with up to ~300 MVA grid connection availability (MVA not converted to MW). Recorded as rejected/stopped negative evidence per DE methodology (Vantage Gross-Gerau-type cancelled-proposal handling). No other commercial datacenter found in Wartburgkreis (Bad Salzungen, Eisenach searches negative).

name: Gemeinsames Rechenzentrum fuer 123 Schulstandorte (shared school data center Wartburgkreis / Schmalkalden-Meiningen)
developer: Landkreis Wartburgkreis / Landkreis Schmalkalden-Meiningen (shared school-IT data center)
notes: District media information (2021) describes a shared Rechenzentrum serving 123 school sites across Wartburgkreis and Schmalkalden-Meiningen; insuedthueringen reporting calls the Schul-Rechenzentrum a milestone for the digital school. Public-sector administrative data-center record; physical hosting may partly run via external providers (KitS/Thueringer Rechenzentrum), so capacity and exact site are not published.

name: Bauhaus-Universitaet Weimar SCC / Konrad-Zuse-Medienhaus computing center
notes: Official university page (checked 2026-08-12) identifies the SCC as the university IT service center at Steubenstrasse 6a, 99423 Weimar, providing central IT services including virtual servers and hosting; architecture sources document the conversion of the former Stadtbrauerei into the computing center/Medienhaus (completed 2002) with ~778.7 sqm Rechenzentrum space. No commercial colocation facility found in Weimar: CustomColo's 'Rechenzentrum Weimar' page is an SEO landing page whose actual facilities are in Hamburg/Berlin/Frankfurt/Duesseldorf/Amsterdam/Copenhagen; UVP-Verbund and datacenter directories show no Weimar datacenter projects.

Method-driven searches on 2026-08-12 for Weimarer Land, Apolda, Bad Berka with terms Rechenzentrum, Datenzentrum, data center, Bebauungsplan, Sondergebiet Rechenzentrum, Baugenehmigung, Netzanschluss and site:uvp-verbund.de found no public datacenter project or facility in the district; results were tourism/administration pages or external hosting providers. No datacenter activity identified.
